overall: The Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by convening its February 15, 2012 executive session under Purpose 6; the deliberation allegation was filed too late, so the AG declined to review it.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Feb 15, 2012 executive session under Purpose 6 was improper because open discussion would not have compromised the Board's negotiating position.
allegations.key_passage: Because there were still several contingencies the Board was considering in the Agreement, we find that the Board had an ongoing negotiation position to protect during its February 15, 2012 meeting.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Board deliberated outside an open meeting to revise the terms of a Purchase and Sale agreement.
allegations.key_passage: Because the complaint was not filed with the Board until April 1, we find that the second allegation was not timely filed, and thus decline to review its merits.
